candidates.source_name: 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) / Epistle of Enoch (1 Enoch 91-108)
candidates.draft_body:
1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Epistle of Enoch (1 Enoch 91-108) (c. 100 BC)

'And after that there shall be still more unrighteousness than that which was first consummated on the earth; for I know the mysteries of the holy ones; for He, the Lord, has showed me and informed me, and I have read them in the heavenly tablets' — the SECOND judgment will exceed the first (Flood). Tewahedo eschatology preserves the second-greater-than-first principle: just as Noah's flood-judgment was decisive but PARTIAL (the human race continued), the final eschatological judgment is total — the typological escalation builds throughout the Mäṣḥafä Hēnok.
